content.description: Cross-section diagram of pressure regulator showing internal components (spring, valve, diaphragm) and external connections. Also shows installation view on vehicle with delivery pipe, fuel return hose, vacuum sensing hose, and No. 2 pressure pipe labeled.
Illustration showing hands disconnecting vacuum sensing hose from pressure regulator

items:
DISCONNECT FUEL HOSE
(a) Put a suitable container or shop towel under the pressure regulator.
(b) Disconnect the fuel hose from the pressure regulator.

content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of No. 2 fuel pipe from pressure regulator

items: DISCONNECT NO. 2 FUEL PIPE FROM PRESSURE REGULATOR

REMOVE PRESSURE REGULATOR
Remove the lock nut, and remove the pressure regulator.

INSTALL PRESSURE REGULATOR
Install the pressure regulator and lock nut.

content.description: Illustration showing connection of No. 2 fuel pipe to pressure regulator

items:
CONNECT NO. 2 FUEL PIPE
Install a new gasket, pipe, another gasket and union bolt to the pressure regulator. Torque the union bolt.
